title: A crescendo wedge and a relative dynamic
description: Two half notes under the two dynamic-group types that carry no absolute value: a gradual group with wedgeType increasing (the crescendo hairpin) starting at beat one, and a relative group with relativeValue louder at beat three. The renderer draws point dynamics only — wedges and relative marks are a known renderer gap, so the goldens pin two unadorned notes; when hairpins land, this golden is the one that moves.
